prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a lively mountain campsite scene. On the left, a man in a blue beanie sits on a log while holding a mug of coffee. Next to him stands a woman in a yellow raincoat who is pointing at a map spread on a rock. A brown dog lies beside the rock, looking up at the woman. In the center, a large orange tent is pitched with its flap open. A child in a green shirt crawls out of the tent entrance. Beside the tent, a silver kettle hangs over a small campfire where logs burn brightly. A man in a red scarf tends to the fire with a stick. To the right of the fire, a black bear statue stands motionless near a tree stump. A raccoon peeks from behind the stump, eyeing a picnic basket. The picnic basket sits on a checkered blanket spread on the grass. A girl in pink boots reaches for a sandwich inside the basket. An older man with glasses watches her from a folding chair nearby. Behind them, a tall pine tree rises against the sky. A hawk perches on a branch of the pine tree. On the far right, two hikers with backpacks walk along a trail. One hiker wears a purple hat and looks back at the camp. The other hiker in a grey jacket carries a walking stick. A squirrel runs up the trunk of a smaller oak tree near the trail. There is no smoke rising from the chimney of any building. There is no water visible in a lake or river. There is no car parked near the site.
